chapters.title: The Count of Israel
chapters.html:
Numbers 1

1And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, saying,

2"Take a count of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, every male, head by head,

3from twenty years old and up, all in Israel who can go out to war. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

4And with you there shall be a man from each tribe, each one the head of his fathers' house.

5And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;

6from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;

7from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

8from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;

9from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;

10from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;

11from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;

12from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

13from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;

14from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;

15from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan."

16These were the ones called from the congregation, the chiefs of their fathers' tribes. They were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

17And Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,

18and they assembled the whole congregation on the first of the second month, and they registered their descent by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and up, head by head,

19as the LORD had commanded Moses. And he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

The Count by Tribes

20And the sons of Reuben, Israel's firstborn — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, head by head, every male twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

21those of them counted, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

22Of the sons of Simeon — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, those of them counted, by the number of names, head by head, every male twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

23those of them counted, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

24Of the sons of Gad — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

25those of them counted, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

26Of the sons of Judah — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

27those of them counted, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

28Of the sons of Issachar — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

29those of them counted, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

30Of the sons of Zebulun — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

31those of them counted, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

32Of the sons of Joseph: of the sons of Ephraim — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

33those of them counted, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

34Of the sons of Manasseh — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

35those of them counted, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

36Of the sons of Benjamin — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

37those of them counted, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

38Of the sons of Dan — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

39those of them counted, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

40Of the sons of Asher — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

41those of them counted, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

42Of the sons of Naphtali — their descendants, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the number of names, twenty years old and up, all who could go out to war:

43those of them counted, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

44These are the ones counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted with the chiefs of Israel, twelve men, each one for his fathers' house.

45And all those counted of the sons of Israel, by their fathers' houses, from twenty years old and up, all in Israel who could go out to war —

46all those counted were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

The Levites

47But the Levites were not counted among them by their fathers' tribe.

48For the LORD had spoken to Moses, saying,

49"Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, and you shall not take a count of them among the sons of Israel.

50But you — appoint the Levites over the dwelling of the Testimony, and over all its vessels, and over everything that belongs to it. They shall carry the dwelling and all its vessels, and they shall serve it, and they shall camp around the dwelling.

51When the dwelling sets out, the Levites shall take it down, and when the dwelling camps, the Levites shall set it up. And the outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

52And the sons of Israel shall camp each in his own camp and each by his own banner, by their divisions.

53But the Levites shall camp around the dwelling of the Testimony, so that there will be no wrath on the congregation of the sons of Israel. And the Levites shall keep the charge of the dwelling of the Testimony."

54And the sons of Israel did so. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.

Notes

  • v1 "in the wilderness" — be-midbar, the Hebrew name of this book, taken from its first line. The English name Numbers comes through Latin from the Greek Arithmoi, named for the two counts of the people (chapters 1 and 26). The date is exact: one month after the dwelling was raised on the first of the first month (Exodus 40:17). Israel has been at Sinai nearly a year.

  • v2 "take a count" — se'u et rosh, literally lift the head. It is the idiom of Joseph's two dreams in prison: Pharaoh will lift your head and restore you, the cupbearer is told, and the baker, lift your head from off you (Genesis 40:13, 19). Head by head is le-gulgelotam, by their skulls, the word behind Golgotha.

  • v3 "all who can go out to war" — kol yotse tsava, everyone who goes out with the army. The count is a muster. The verb, paqad, is to count and also to attend to, to take charge of, and to visit. The count is God taking stock of what He brought out of Egypt.

  • v16 "the heads of the thousands of Israel" — elef means a thousand, and it also means a clan, a family unit: my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, Gideon says (Judges 6:15), using this word. The census totals in this chapter are written with elef. Read as thousands, the fighting men number 603,550, the same figure as the half-shekel count in Exodus 38:26. Read as clans or units, the numbers would be far smaller. Both senses of the word are real; the totals the text itself adds up (v46) follow the thousand reading.

  • v17 "designated by name" — nikkevu, from naqav, the verb used of the man who blasphemed the Name in Leviticus 24:11. The same verb that marks a name out for honor here marks it out for abuse there.

  • v18 "registered their descent" — va-yityaldu, a form of yalad, to give birth, that occurs here and nowhere else: they had themselves born, each one stating whose son he was. The count of an army is also a roll of ancestry.

  • v20 "Reuben, Israel's firstborn" — the list opens with the firstborn, as Genesis 49 did, and names Joseph's two sons as tribes (vv32–35), as Jacob did when he adopted them (Genesis 48:5). Levi is missing from the twelve; Ephraim and Manasseh keep the count at twelve.

  • vv47–53 the Levites are not counted — the tribe that carries the dwelling is not mustered for war. It camps around the dwelling as a living wall, so that there will be no wrath on the congregation: the Levites stand between the people and the holy place.

chapters.title: The Camp Around the Tent
chapters.html:
Numbers 2

1And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

2"The sons of Israel shall camp each by his own banner, under the signs of their fathers' houses. They shall camp facing the tent of meeting, at a distance, all around it.

East: Judah

3Those camping on the east side, toward the sunrise, shall be the banner of the camp of Judah by their divisions. The chief of the sons of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab,

4and his army, those of them counted, seventy-four thousand six hundred.

5And those camping next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The chief of the sons of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar,

6and his army, those of it counted, fifty-four thousand four hundred.

7Then the tribe of Zebulun. The chief of the sons of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon,

8and his army, those of it counted, fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

9All those counted for the camp of Judah, by their divisions, one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred. They shall set out first.

South: Reuben

10The banner of the camp of Reuben shall be on the south, by their divisions. The chief of the sons of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur,

11and his army, those of it counted, forty-six thousand five hundred.

12And those camping next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The chief of the sons of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,

13and his army, those of them counted, fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

14Then the tribe of Gad. The chief of the sons of Gad is Eliasaph son of Reuel,

15and his army, those of them counted, forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

16All those counted for the camp of Reuben, by their divisions, one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty. They shall set out second.

The Tent in the Middle

17And the tent of meeting shall set out, the camp of the Levites, in the middle of the camps. As they camp, so they shall set out, each in his place, by their banners.

West: Ephraim

18The banner of the camp of Ephraim shall be on the west, by their divisions. The chief of the sons of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud,

19and his army, those of them counted, forty thousand five hundred.

20And next to him the tribe of Manasseh. The chief of the sons of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,

21and his army, those of them counted, thirty-two thousand two hundred.

22Then the tribe of Benjamin. The chief of the sons of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni,

23and his army, those of them counted, thirty-five thousand four hundred.

24All those counted for the camp of Ephraim, by their divisions, one hundred and eight thousand one hundred. They shall set out third.

North: Dan

25The banner of the camp of Dan shall be on the north, by their divisions. The chief of the sons of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,

26and his army, those of them counted, sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

27And those camping next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The chief of the sons of Asher is Pagiel son of Ocran,

28and his army, those of them counted, forty-one thousand five hundred.

29Then the tribe of Naphtali. The chief of the sons of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan,

30and his army, those of them counted, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

31All those counted for the camp of Dan, one hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last, by their banners."

32These are those of the sons of Israel counted by their fathers' houses. All those counted in the camps, by their divisions, were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

33But the Levites were not counted among the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

34And the sons of Israel did according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses. So they camped by their banners, and so they set out, each by his clans, by his fathers' house.

Notes

  • v2 "facing the tent of meeting, at a distance" — mi-neged saviv, opposite and all around. Every tent in Israel faces the dwelling, and none comes close. Four camps of three tribes make a square, the Levites form an inner ring (1:53), and the tent of meeting stands in the middle (v17). When the camp moves, it keeps the same shape.

  • v3 "on the east side, toward the sunrise" — qedmah mizrachah. The entrance to the court of the dwelling faces the sunrise (Exodus 27:13), and Judah camps in front of it and marches first. The largest tribe holds the door. East is also where the way back into Eden was guarded (Genesis 3:24).

  • v10, 18, 25 the four directions — Hebrew names them by where a person stands facing the sunrise: qedem, east, is also before, in front; teiman, south, is from yamin, the right hand; the west is yam, the sea; the north, tsafon, is from a root meaning hidden. The camp is laid out as a man facing east would see the world.

  • v14 "Eliasaph son of Reuel" — in 1:14 and three more times (7:42, 7:47, 10:20) his father is Deuel. The Hebrew letters d and r are nearly the same shape, and one of the two spellings is a copyist's slip. The Greek has Reuel in every place. The text stands as the Hebrew has it in each verse.

  • v17 "as they camp, so they shall set out" — the tent of meeting marches in the middle, with two camps ahead of it and two behind. The order of the march is the order of the camp, and God's dwelling is at the center of both.

  • v32 "six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty" — the total of chapter 1, now broken into four camps of 186,400, 151,450, 108,100 and 157,600. The four add up exactly. On thousand and clan, see the note on 1:16.
